classification: local release-fast benchmark on the development hub; not a production, fleet or freshness qualification
objective: reduce recent-worker tail prewarm (attempt 14: 10.13-11.34 s for the two sequential native tail builds at build_slots 1) after publication-freshness-2026-10-03 left projected burst visibility at 31-34 s

sources.final: d6a26f19 (code); aedeb5eb introduced the batched hint
sources.baseline: d6a26f19 with base-runtime.patch applied: TableRuntime::build calls pir_native::hint, the runtime of 8a61b52d
sources.unchanged: ipir-sp/reinspiring v0.1.0-rc.6 (1f2aec6), shared/pir-native, native parameters, seeds, geometry, seal policy, wire and runtime snapshot formats

build.profile: release-fast (target-cpu=native from .cargo/config.toml; the hub has AVX2/BMI2 and no AVX-512, deploy builds use x86-64-v3); no deploy artifact was built
build.command: tool-exec --repo wallet-pir -- cargo build --profile release-fast -p transparent-shard-server --example hint_bench
build.target_lane: task-owned CARGO_TARGET_DIR reused for every build

workload.inputs: the final-cycle tail candidate of each fill retained by publication-freshness-2026-10-03 (publication_bench from the retained mainnet day; representative synthetic data, not a production replay); digests in runs/<fill>-inputs.sha256 match that run's published-trees.json
workload.geometry: recent-8k: directory and pages, 8,192 x 4,096-byte rows each

fills.10.2: 24% page fill, pages 1 of 4 hint blocks used

workload.threads: TRANSPARENT_BUILD_THREADS=2, a 4-vCPU recent worker's default build pool (nice 10)

commands.comparison: prewarm-compare.sh <attempt-1 bench>/cmp runs (alternates base and final twice per fill, three rounds of directory then pages each; then the in-process hint comparison with the final binary)
commands.focused_tests: cargo test --profile release-fast -p transparent-native -p transparent-shard-server --lib --test round_trip --test revisions_and_cache

not_retained: a first identical comparison run from binaries built before rustfmt reflowed two lines of hint_bench.rs (no semantic change) gave the same results within noise (97% fill 4.95 -> 3.04 s); it was superseded by runs/ and deleted
